subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Three Stages of Laundering
description: Learn The Three Stages of Laundering in one minute.

hook.text: Drug cartels earn billions in cash. They can't deposit it without questions. So they wash it clean.

buildup.text: Money laundering has three stages: placement (inject cash), layering (move it around), integration (use it).

discovery.text: Placement is hardest — physically depositing large amounts of cash triggers automatic bank reports.

twist.text: Layering uses shell companies, wire transfers, and foreign banks to make the money untraceable.

climax.text: By integration, the money looks clean. It buys real estate, businesses, and luxury goods legally.

punchline.text: Place it. Layer it. Integrate it. Dirty money made clean.

quiz.question: What are the three stages of money laundering?
